name: dsh-status-light
description: DSH Web GUI plugin: a global red/yellow/green status light. Sidebar status dot + text label in the Web GUI footer and a matching colored browser-tab favicon (title untouched) show at a glance whether any DSH session is blocked waiting for human input (red: approval / question / plan-review pending), an agent is running (yellow), or everything is idle (green). A read-only desktop status bridge (GET /session-status + /session-status/stream SSE) is mounted on the already-running web server (no new port) so a desktop tray tool can mirror the same state without a browser. The tab-icon mode (replace vs. overlay the original favicon) and the bridge toggle are configured in Settings → 状态监控 (Status monitoring) and persist in the `session-status` settings namespace. Keywords: dsh, deepseek-harness, plugin, session, status, traffic-light, tray, desktop.
